{
 "path": "android/app/src/main/java/com/firstaid/copilot/live/edge/EdgeCallBudget.kt",
 "contents": "package com.firstaid.copilot.live.edge\n\n/**\n * Sliding-window call budget for the single on-device Gemma driver.\n *\n * [EdgeGemmaAgent] uses this to cap how many open-question generations may run per\n * minute, so a burst of out-of-flow questions can never saturate the one\n * CPU-bound driver (and starve the interactive hot path that always runs\n * deterministically first). At most [maxCalls] acquisitions succeed inside any\n * [windowMs] window.\n *\n * The clock is injected via the `nowMs` parameter (the agent passes its own\n * `clockMs()`), so exhaustion and window-reset behavior are unit-tested\n * deterministically without real time. All methods are synchronized because the\n * agent may probe the budget from different coroutine dispatch threads.\n */\nclass EdgeCallBudget(\n    private val maxCalls: Int,\n    private val windowMs: Long = 60_000L,\n) {\n    private val timestamps = ArrayDeque<Long>()\n\n    /** Reserve one call slot at [nowMs]; returns `false` when the window is already full. */\n    @Synchronized\n    fun tryAcquire(nowMs: Long): Boolean {\n        evictExpired(nowMs)\n        if (maxCalls <= 0 || timestamps.size >= maxCalls) return false\n        timestamps.addLast(nowMs)\n        return true\n    }\n\n    /** Live count of reservations still inside the window at [nowMs]. */\n    @Synchronized\n    fun activeCount(nowMs: Long): Int {\n        evictExpired(nowMs)\n        return timestamps.size\n    }\n\n    @Synchronized\n    fun reset() {\n        timestamps.clear()\n    }\n\n    private fun evictExpired(nowMs: Long) {\n        while (timestamps.isNotEmpty() && nowMs - timestamps.first() >= windowMs) {\n            timestamps.removeFirst()\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

The clock is injected, so exhaustion and\n * window-reset are deterministic.\n */\nclass EdgeCallBudgetTest {\n\n    @Test\n    fun blocksOnceTheWindowIsFull() {\n        val budget = EdgeCallBudget(maxCalls = 3, windowMs = 60_000L)\n        assertTrue(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 0))\n        assertTrue(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 100))\n        assertTrue(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 200))\n        assertFalse(\"4th call inside the window is rejected\", budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 1_000))\n        assertEquals(3, budget.activeCount(nowMs = 1_000))\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    fun releasesCapacityAsTheWindowSlides() {\n        val budget = EdgeCallBudget(maxCalls = 2, windowMs = 60_000L)\n        assertTrue(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 0))\n        assertTrue(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 0))\n        assertFalse(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 59_999))\n        assertEquals(\"still full just before the window expires\", 2, budget.activeCount(nowMs = 59_999))\n        assertTrue(\"a slot frees once now - oldest >= windowMs\", budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 60_000))\n        assertEquals(1, budget.activeCount(nowMs = 60_000))\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    fun matchesTheAgentDefaultBudget() {\n        // The agent constructs EdgeCallBudget(OPEN_QUESTION_BUDGET_PER_MINUTE); prove that\n        // many distinct questions in a minute eventually hit the ceiling and then recover.\n        val budget = EdgeCallBudget(maxCalls = EdgeGemmaAgent.OPEN_QUESTION_BUDGET_PER_MINUTE)\n        val allowedInFirstMinute = (0 until 30).count { i -> budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = i * 100L) }\n        assertEquals(EdgeGemmaAgent.OPEN_QUESTION_BUDGET_PER_MINUTE, allowedInFirstMinute)\n        assertFalse(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 3_500L))\n        // A full window later, the budget is available again.\n        assertTrue(budget.tryAcquire(nowMs = 70_000L))\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    fun zeroMaxAlwaysBlocks() {\n        assertFalse(EdgeCallBudget(maxCalls = 0).tryAcquire(nowMs = 0))\n    }\n}\n"
}
```

**B. 推理层（当前未提交，在工作区）** — 生产 Live 链路把 NLU 整个推理契约换了：

- 新：**模型只输出一个候选英文标签**（纯文本，不要 JSON/标点），prompt 改成 `[候选标签] no_normal_breathing / ... / clarify_breathing`，规则简化为"不确定就选 `clarify_breathing`"。
- 结构、红线、clarify 判定全交给新的 `EdgeGuidanceGuard.validateNluText()`：匹配 allow-list、对 `suspected_cardiac_arrest` 红线无条件拒、标签以 `clarify` 开头则 `needsClarification=true`。`EdgeGemmaAgent` 也从 `validateNlu` 改调 `validateNluText`，并配了新单测。→ 直接消灭根因 2（输出 token 极少，几乎不会卡死/解析失败）。

## 旁证：这条"纯文本"路线确实有效（6/7 GPU 真机产物）
这两个新产物虽然测的是开放问答，但走的是和 NLU 同一条 plaintext 路线，对比很能说明问题：

| 方案（同问题/同 GPU） | 单次生成延迟 p50 | 输出 |
|---|---|---|
| 仍要 JSON（`edge-gemma-slim-gpu-prompt`） | ~8.1s | ` ```json\n{...` |
| 改纯文本一句话（`edge-gemma-plaintext-gpu`） | **~3.4s** | `继续按压，别停。` |

即 JSON→纯文本砍掉约 60% 延迟；而且 GPU 后端相比 6/6 的 CPU（NLU 单次 ~45s）快了一个数量级。不过 3.4s 仍 > 1200ms 门控，所以依旧是 `ack_then_async`（先应答、后台异步）。

## 还差什么（关键缺口）
- **没提交**：B 这套改动还在工作区。
- **没有 NLU 的真机新数字**：6/7 的 GPU 产物是开放问答裸推理，不是 `gemma-suite` 的 NLU；而 `gemma-suite` 那条线 6/6 之后每次都停在预热没跑完。
- **探针没对齐**：`assets/gemma_suite/nlu_*.json` 里预渲染的 prompt 还是旧的"输出完整 JSON + slots"版，跟生产新的单标签方案已经漂移——不重渲染的话，新 NLU 方案就没有探针数据背书。

## 现象
给到 30s，`patch` 三次仍然整齐 `30001ms` 超时、空输出。也就是这个探针在 GPU 上 30s 都不收敛。

所以 `gemma-suite` 对 `patch`/`handover` 喂的是 **Node 端的 verbose JSON prompt**（`patch` 足足 4008 字符）+ 要求完整 JSON 输出。GPU 上"长 prefill + 长 JSON 输出"30s 不收敛是**预期内的**——这恰恰就是当初把 C/E 端侧化成精简单标签/纯文本的原因。对照看就很清楚：

| 探针 | prompt 字符 | 输出形态 | GPU 结果 |
|------|------------|---------|---------|
| nlu（已迁 plaintext） | ~精简 | 单标签 | **8s 通过** |
| patch（Node verbose JSON） | 4008 | 完整 JSON | 30s 超时 |
| open_question（Node verbose JSON） | 3897 | 完整 JSON | 同样超时 |

`open_question`(C) 其实有端侧 plaintext builder（生产已用 `validateOpenQuestionText`），只是 `gemma-suite` 探针没迁——迁了就能像 NLU 一样快。而 `patch`/`handover` 端侧没有精简实现，纯靠加 timeout 硬等意义不大（它们本就不是端侧实时功能）。
